customer_message.subject: Mould and damp in the children's room, Kirchgasse 34, Winterthur
customer_message.body: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to ask for your help with a defect in my rented flat at Kirchgasse 34, Winterthur, a 4.5-room flat that I rent from Immobilien Seeblick AG. In the children's room there are mould stains and damp patches on the walls, and the problem has been there for some months. I reported it to the landlord in writing on 3 September 2026, but nothing has been done so far. Some rooms in the flat also feel cold. I am not sure whether the heating is actually faulty, as I am not an expert and I have not had it checked. I only mention it because it may be related. I would like the landlord to remove the mould and fix the damp problem within a reasonable time. If the defect is not fixed, I intend to pay the rent into the official rent deposit (Hinterlegung) as provided by law, and I would like to know what steps I need to take. Could you please let me know how you can support me and what documents you need from me? I can send photos of the walls and a copy of my letter to the landlord. Thank you for your help. Kind regards, Rowan Price
